{{Quote|Star Tours, Follow the ship. It's-a gonna lead you, thru da planet's core.|Gungan Bongo Pilot|<ref name="ST2" />}}
[[File:ST2_Bongo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The pilot's Tribubble bongo travels underwater on Naboo]]
During the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] ([[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]), a '''Gungan''' in a [[Bongo]] vehicle escorted a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]]-owned [[StarSpeeder 1000]] to a [[Naboo Rebel hangar|Rebel hangar]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] via the planet core, after the vessel had dived into the water to avoid [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture'' droids]] from the [[Skirmish over Naboo (Galactic Civil War)|ensuing battle]] above, and after its original escort, three [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]], were shot down. It was eventually ambushed by an [[Opee sea killer/Legends|Opee sea killer]], although it managed to escape from its jaws via a [[Sando aqua monster/Legends|Sando aqua monster]].<ref name="ST2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Since the [[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue|''Star Tours'']] attraction visits one of three different planets during each segment of the ride, this starfighter pilot does not always appear.<ref name="ST2" />
